meaning: Source-level Node cases executed during validation of the bound artifact; compiled document tasks are reported separately in revision14-browser.json and mobile-accessibility.json.

tests.name: The independent pinned-CDB audit is available and checks its source hash before comparison
Live counts conserve the shipped catalogue while separating unresolved IDs and missing statistics
Every unresolved ID, classification and unknown-stat identity agrees with the independent source audit
Candidate passcodes match the pinned primary SQLite names and remain proposals rather than replacements
Ambiguous name matches preserve every proposed identity without selecting or applying the first result
Legacy source declarations never acquire an unrelated pinned URL, hash or official identity claim
Known zero attack and question-mark technical values are not reclassified as missing statistics
Mutable presentation objects cannot invent a source match or fill unknown statistics
The diagnostic keeps its immutable minimum raw snapshot after shared embedded rows are changed
An active inventory change is visible instead of silently changing the shipped identity baseline
Exported reports retain build and catalogue bindings and cannot mutate later diagnostics
A changed build or catalogue hash is marked stale without rebinding the captured catalogue
Format context is exported as a detached context without manufacturing availability evidence
Reporting, exporting, refreshing and the Node download adapter preserve every deck and raw catalogue row
An incomplete embedded payload fails initialization instead of claiming a complete bound catalogue

limitations: The pinned SQLite source is a secondary technical snapshot, not official identity, availability or ruling certification.
No statistics, passcodes, proposals or decks are automatically rewritten; the tests do not validate a competitive score.
